nom: Hero Cosmetics Glow Balm Radiant Skin Stick

avis.texte: I put it on before I go to sleep. I feel so hydrated. It's great!

I use this instead of highlihter and it looks so much better and natural and I'm a highlighter queen. I also put it on forehead above nose and ever since I started doing this everyone who meets me comments on what beautiful healthy skin I have when in reality my skin isn't that great it's just an illusion from this but it makes me look so young. I also apply it before travel and usually at least once in plane or airport and once upon arriving and it keeps my skin from drying out. Someone commented that I look like the most well-hydrated person ever haha but it just gives a beautiful lit from within glow.
I was expecting a lighter texture, but it's cumbersome, too thick. I feel my skin cannot breathe. I don't really like it.
Just not for me for the prize. Didn't feel as hydrating comparing to some other highlighting glow balm which provide a little more shine.
I love this product. I use it every night before bed on my undereyes and it makes my skin glowy and hydrated for the next day. Super easy to use ! 🎀
